program_authority.rule: Branches and pull requests are implementation slices. The product finish line is the whole-product law plus the mathematical research-program invariants plus this program contract plus complete installed-product acceptance.

terminal_definition.statement: Laplace is finished only when the exact accepted package executes the complete configured machine from acquisition and activation through canonical world state, cognition, realization/effects, learning, product surfaces, recovery, readback, receipts and release acceptance without a private semantic engine, loss of the mathematical research-program state distinctions, or forbidden physical-plan substitution.

work_state_machine.supersession_rule: A superseded issue PR branch contract or document must name its successor; it cannot remain the current finish-line authority.

research_program_preservation.rule: Every material implementation slice must preserve the applicable coupled-machine state distinctions and map any later direct correction into the governing requirement contract issue and deliberate-defect acceptance before a conflicting lower-authority shortcut can become architecture.

progress_accounting.rule: Progress is reduction or closure of an explicit executable exit predicate acceptance obligation prerequisite or branch-reconciliation obligation. Activity artifacts alone do not count.
progress_accounting.continuation_rule: After corrections status questions review findings or failed checks, continue safe in-scope work on the same dependency chain until an executable boundary advances, a real blocker is reached, or the user stops or changes direction.

milestones.operation_model_title: Phase 1 — Industrial build and dependency foundation

operational_graph.coverage_rule: Every current operation-model stage and every phase referenced by a stage must map to exactly one finish-line milestone. The operation model owns stage enumeration; this contract must not maintain a divergent copied stage list.

anti_substitution_controls.coverage_rule: Every critical control must have an owning positive acceptance and a deliberate-defect or mutation somewhere in the acceptance graph before the owning milestone can close.

rework_escalation.rule: When the same defect class appears in two independent leaves, the next primary change must identify and repair the generic semantic or physical owner before another leaf-only patch can count as progress.

current_sprints.outcome: Make composition execution generic, dependency-aware, single-calculation and resource-conserved before world admission or performance work builds on it.

items.exit_condition: The execution grant/provider authority exposes the CPU/memory/concurrency controls required by component execution without private resource pools.
items.immediate_next_action: Consume the existing execution grant/provider boundary from composition rather than inventing another scheduler.

items.exit_condition: Composition execution is admitted through the common framework/provider/receipt lifecycle and cannot create a private execution framework.
items.immediate_next_action: Keep provider selection and receipts in the common framework while #177 integrates ready-frontier execution.

items.exit_condition: One semantic composition DAG executes dependency frontiers through admitted resource/provider authority with scalar parity, deterministic merge, bounded concurrent memory and receipted single-object scaling.
items.immediate_next_action: After frontier-plan acceptance, pre-size per-request slots and execute each ready frontier through the existing execution provider.

items.exit_condition: Normal composition executes each semantic request once; planning uses bounded/static work or retained prepared results and exact reconciliation without a discarded duplicate semantic pass.
items.immediate_next_action: Retain prepared request calculations or replace exact dry-run calculation with a cheaper bounded preflight before provider execution.

items.exit_condition: Legal read/feed/batch/worker/schedule/deposit plans produce an identical normalized canonical world fingerprint across materially different source families.
items.immediate_next_action: Extend source-profile conformance to consume the corrected execution plan and compare semantic fingerprints across worker and batching variants.

direct_correction_capture.rule: A closed historical audit is a bounded evidence checkpoint, not permission to ignore later direct corrections. Every material direct correction must map to an existing requirement/contract/issue/test or create/update one before it can disappear from the active obligation graph.

refactor_benchmarks.rule: Refactor performance is earned only by its own receipted execution over matched semantic work and acceptance boundaries.

issue_pr_contract.pr_rule: A PR may deliver an implementation slice but can never become the product completion authority. Every implementation PR must leave an exact progress receipt rather than activity-only status.
